semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in distributing semiconductor-related and SMT manufacturing equipment, serving key segments of the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Win-Win Electronic Technology International Limited distributes high-tech equipment for semiconductor and SMT manufacturing in Mainland China and Hong Kong. The company caters to chip design companies, wafer fabrication plants, semiconductor packaging and testing plants, and circuit board manufacturing plants.

regional_presence.China: The company has branch offices in Beijing, Shenzhen, and Shanghai, supporting its distribution network.
regional_presence.Hong Kong: Headquartered in Hong Kong, serving as a central hub for operations.
